breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original contradiction by specifying both 'gamma-centered' and 'half shift' for the k-point grids in both the vc-relax and scf calculations. The ground truth resolves this by removing the gamma-centered instruction entirely, keeping only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. The agent failed to identify and fix this conflict.
